normalizedSpaces.label: Consciousness science
normalizedSpaces.rationale: ASSC explicitly organizes rigorous scientific research on the nature, function and mechanisms of consciousness across cognitive science, neuroscience, philosophy, medicine and other sciences/humanities. This supports a stable cross-cutting external identity rather than forcing consciousness into Psychology, Neuroscience or Philosophy alone.

normalizedSpaces.label: Affective science
normalizedSpaces.rationale: The Society for Affective Science explicitly defines affective science around emotion and related phenomena including moods, stress, attitudes, valuation and motivation, with basic/translational work spanning psychology, neuroscience, medicine, language, culture, development and other fields.

normalizedSpaces.label: Developmental science (human development)
normalizedSpaces.rationale: SRCD explicitly identifies developmental science as its scientific domain, while APA Division 7 independently organizes developmental psychology around process-oriented research on normal development and developmental psychopathology in children and families. The coordinate is Human-development focused and remains distinct from developmental biology.

repairs.pressure: HF2/subjectivity and HD11/HD15 projections could only be mapped coarsely through Psychology/Cognitive Science/Neuroscience/Philosophy of Mind.
repairs.repair: Normalize Consciousness Science as an independent cross-cutting external coordinate.

repairs.pressure: HD2/HF21/HOC10 affect/regulation research had only generic Psychology/Neuroscience coordinates.
repairs.repair: Normalize Affective Science as a cross-cutting affect/emotion process domain.

repairs.pressure: HF6 adaptation/plasticity/development had no Human-development coordinate distinct from Developmental Biology.
repairs.repair: Normalize Developmental Science (human development) as a Human-development/psychology-biology bridge.
